name: stem-probe
description: Tiny deterministic probe corpus for the optional English inflectional stemmer (feature=semantic, stem_enable=1). Each probe eval_query shares NO literal content token with its target store_query; the only bridges are regular-plural stems (restarts->restart, timeouts->timeout, dependencies->dependency, rollbacks->rollback, configs->config). root_cause/fix use neutral words so they create no accidental literal overlap. Not a Gauge gate replacement; zero-signal recall probe only.

cases.store_query: oom kill and restart loop after memory pressure
cases.eval_query: oom kill restart loop memory pressure

cases.store_query: memory pressure triggered an oom kill and a restart loop
cases.eval_query: why did restarts cause repeated kills following the deploy

cases.store_query: gateway returned connection reset when upstream timeout exceeded
the gateway returned a connection reset when upstream timeout exceeded threshold
cases.eval_query: clients observed repeated resets after pools reached timeouts

cases.store_query: build failed after a new dependency introduced breaking change
the build failed after a new dependency introduced a breaking change
cases.eval_query: multiple builds broke when dependencies pulled incompatible updates

cases.store_query: node crashed repeatedly until rollback recovered the pod
the node crashed repeatedly until a rollback recovered the pod
cases.eval_query: nodes kept crashing after rollbacks restored pods

cases.store_query: deploy emitted new errors after the config change
the deploy emitted new errors after the config change
cases.eval_query: releases surfaced fresh exceptions after configs drifted
